profile_text.body:
TSMC, or Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, is a public company founded in 1987 and headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan. It trades under the ticker TSM. On its own site the company describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987, saying it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions.

The site also describes how TSMC and its business model accelerate innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and how the company contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy. No AI-specific products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
